notes_endorse: Editorial 'He Loves the Country' (reprinted from Denison Herald) — 'Such a man should make a good president for all the people.' Praises FDR's rural sympathies and reforestation work

Viewpoints column 'For President' reprints Cleveland Plain Dealer endorsement of FDR for re-election. 'We prefer Mr. Roosevelt because his philosophy of government is attuned to what we regard as inevitable social and economic trends.'
